name: When should I consider professional help for peeling paint repair instead of a DIY fix?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider professional help for peeling paint repair instead of a DIY fix?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider professional help if the peeling paint covers a large area, involves lead-based paint, or if the underlying cause is unknown. Professionals can safely remove old paint, identify and address moisture sources, and ensure proper surface preparation for a durable finish. For homes built before 1978, testing for lead paint is essential, as its removal requires specialized safety protocols to prevent health hazards. Large-scale repairs also benefit from professional tools and expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Opt for professional help when peeling paint covers a large area, involves lead paint, or if the underlying cause is unclear.
